name: smwsprites-laser-from-quick-man-s-stage
title: Laser from Quick Man's stage
description:
A laser as annoying as the ones in Quick Man's stage. Has 4 configurable directions, and it can play a sound effect.

Note that this works by spawning a custom map16 tile: if it were merely sprites it'd be overkill. Because of that, don't put a lot of them in a single screen or you'll get black bars at the top.
